entities.name: Yusuf Haji Nur
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yusuf Haji Nur was a Somali politician and lawyer who served as Chief Justice of Puntland in 2001, and from 2016 to 2019. He was the acting President of Puntland in 2001.
